    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.set_ylabel("Reconstruction Error", color="tab:red")
    ax2.plot(results["n_components"], results["reconstruction_error"], color="tab:red", label="Reconstruction error")
    ax2.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="tab:red")
    _save_plot(fig, f"{filename}-pca-components.png")

    if verbose:
        best_row = results.sort_values(["explained_variance_ratio", "reconstruction_error"], ascending=[False, True]).iloc[0]
        print("PCA best components:", int(best_row["n_components"]))

    return results


def ulICA(X, y, random_seed, filename, verbose=False):
    del y
    X_array = _as_array(X)
    rows = []

    for n_components in _component_range(X_array):
        model = FastICA(n_components=n_components, random_state=random_seed, max_iter=1000)
        transformed = model.fit_transform(X_array)
        reconstructed = model.inverse_transform(transformed)
        rows.append(
            {
                "n_components": n_components,
                "mean_abs_kurtosis": float(np.mean(np.abs(kurtosis(transformed, axis=0, fisher=True, bias=False)))),
                "reconstruction_error": _reconstruction_error(X_array, reconstructed),
            }
        )

    results = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if results.empty:
        return results

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()
    ax1.set_title("ICA Component Selection")
    ax1.set_xlabel("Number of Components")
    ax1.set_ylabel("Mean |Kurtosis|", color="tab:blue")
    ax1.plot(results["n_components"], results["mean_abs_kurtosis"], color="tab:blue")
    ax1.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="tab:blue")
    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.set_ylabel("Reconstruction Error", color="tab:red")
    ax2.plot(results["n_components"], results["reconstruction_error"], color="tab:red")
    ax2.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="tab:red")
    _save_plot(fig, f"{filename}-ica-components.png")

    if verbose:
        best_row = results.sort_values(["mean_abs_kurtosis", "reconstruction_error"], ascending=[False, True]).iloc[0]
        print("ICA best components:", int(best_row["n_components"]))

    return results


def randProj(X, y, random_seed, filename, verbose=False):
    del y
    X_array = _as_array(X)
    rows = []
    seeds = [random_seed + offset for offset in range(5)]

    for n_components in _component_range(X_array):
        errors = []
        for seed in seeds:
            model = GRP(n_components=n_components, random_state=seed)
            transformed = model.fit_transform(X_array)
            reconstructed = transformed @ np.linalg.pinv(model.components_.T)
            errors.append(_reconstruction_error(X_array, reconstructed))
        rows.append(
            {
                "n_components": n_components,
                "mean_reconstruction_error": float(np.mean(errors)),
                "std_reconstruction_error": float(np.std(errors)),
            }
        )

    results = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if results.empty:
        return results

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.set_title("Random Projection Reconstruction Error")
    ax.set_xlabel("Number of Components")
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean Reconstruction Error")
    ax.plot(results["n_components"], results["mean_reconstruction_error"], color="tab:blue")
    ax.fill_between(
        results["n_components"],
        results["mean_reconstruction_error"] - results["std_reconstruction_error"],
        results["mean_reconstruction_error"] + results["std_reconstruction_error"],
        alpha=0.2,
        color="tab:blue",
    )
    _save_plot(fig, f"{filename}-grp-components.png")

    if verbose:
        best_row = results.sort_values("mean_reconstruction_error", ascending=True).iloc[0]
        print("GRP best components:", int(best_row["n_components"]))

    return results


def ul_LLE(X, y, random_seed, filename, verbose=False):
    del y
    X_array = _as_array(X)
    n_samples, n_features = X_array.shape
    n_neighbors = min(10, n_samples - 1)
    max_components = min(20, n_features - 1, n_neighbors - 1, n_samples - 2)

    if max_components < 1:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["n_components", "reconstruction_error"])

    rows = []
    for n_components in range(1, max_components + 1):
        model = LocallyLinearEmbedding(
            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
            n_components=n_components,
            random_state=random_seed,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
        try:
            model.fit_transform(X_array)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "n_components": n_components,
                    "reconstruction_error": float(model.reconstruction_error_),
                }
            )
        except Exception:
            rows.append({"n_components": n_components, "reconstruction_error": np.nan})

    results = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if results.empty:
        return results

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.set_title("LLE Reconstruction Error")
    ax.set_xlabel("Number of Components")
    ax.set_ylabel("Reconstruction Error")
    ax.plot(results["n_components"], results["reconstruction_error"], color="tab:blue")
    _save_plot(fig, f"{filename}-lle-components.png")

    if verbose and results["reconstruction_error"].notna().any():
        best_row = results.dropna().sort_values("reconstruction_error", ascending=True).iloc[0]
        print("LLE best components:", int(best_row["n_components"]))

    return results

# Citation: https://matplotlib.org/3.1.1/gallery/images_contours_and_fields/image_annotated_heatmap.html
def heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, ax=None, cbar_kw={}, cbarlabel="", **kwargs):
    """
    Create a heatmap from a numpy array and two lists of labels.

    Parameters
    ----------
    data
        A 2D numpy array of shape (N, M).
    row_labels
        A list or array of length N with the labels for the rows.
    col_labels
        A list or array of length M with the labels for the columns.
    ax
        A `matplotlib.axes.Axes` instance to which the heatmap is plotted.  If
        not provided, use current axes or create a new one.  Optional.
    cbar_kw
        A dictionary with arguments to `matplotlib.Figure.colorbar`.  Optional.
    cbarlabel
        The label for the colorbar.  Optional.
    **kwargs
        All other arguments are forwarded to `imshow`.
    """

    if not ax:
        ax = plt.gca()

    # Plot the heatmap
    im = ax.imshow(data, **kwargs)

    # Create colorbar
    cbar = ax.figure.colorbar(im, ax=ax, **cbar_kw)
    cbar.ax.set_ylabel(cbarlabel, rotation=-90, va="bottom")

    # We want to show all ticks...
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1]))
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0]))
    # ... and label them with the respective list entries.
    ax.set_xticklabels(col_labels)
    ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels)

    # Let the horizontal axes labeling appear on top.
    ax.tick_params(top=True, bottom=False,
                   labeltop=True, labelbottom=False)

    # Rotate the tick labels and set their alignment.
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=-30, ha="right",
             rotation_mode="anchor")
    plt.title('epsilon')
    plt.ylabel('gamma')

    # Turn spines off and create white grid.
    for edge, spine in ax.spines.items():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1] + 1) - .5, minor=True)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0] + 1) - .5, minor=True)
    ax.grid(which="minor", color="w", linestyle='-', linewidth=3)
    ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)

    return im, cbar


def annotate_heatmap(im, data=None, valfmt="{x:.2f}", textcolors=["black", "white"], threshold=None, **textkw):
    """
    A function to annotate a heatmap.

    Parameters
    ----------
    im
        The AxesImage to be labeled.
    data
        Data used to annotate.  If None, the image's data is used.  Optional.
    valfmt
        The format of the annotations inside the heatmap.  This should either
        use the string format method, e.g. "$ {x:.2f}", or be a
        `matplotlib.ticker.Formatter`.  Optional.
    textcolors
        A list or array of two color specifications.  The first is used for
        values below a threshold, the second for those above.  Optional.
    threshold
        Value in data units according to which the colors from textcolors are
        applied.  If None (the default) uses the middle of the colormap as
        separation.  Optional.
    **kwargs
        All other arguments are forwarded to each call to `text` used to create
        the text labels.
    """

    if not isinstance(data, (list, np.ndarray)):
        data = im.get_array()

    # Normalize the threshold to the images color range.
    if threshold is not None:
        threshold = im.norm(threshold)
    else:
        threshold = im.norm(data.max()) / 2.

    # Set default alignment to center, but allow it to be
    # overwritten by textkw.
    kw = dict(horizontalalignment="center",
              verticalalignment="center")
    kw.update(textkw)

    # Get the formatter in case a string is supplied
    if isinstance(valfmt, str):
        valfmt = matplotlib.ticker.StrMethodFormatter(valfmt)

    # Loop over the data and create a `Text` for each "pixel".
    # Change the text's color depending on the data.
    texts = []
    for i in range(data.shape[0]):
        for j in range(data.shape[1]):
            kw.update(color=textcolors[int(im.norm(data[i, j]) > threshold)])
            text = im.axes.text(j, i, valfmt(data[i, j], None), **kw)
            texts.append(text)

    return texts

            iters_hm[g_cnt][e_cnt] = pi.iter

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    ax.legend()
    plt.xlabel('Iterations', fontsize=15)

    plt.show()

    op_list = [list(best_pol)]
    print(best_pol_arr)

    # Plot Percent Games Won Heatmap
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    im, cbar = heatmap(per_won_hm, gammas, epsilons, ax=ax,
                       cmap="YlGn", cbarlabel="Average Reward")
    texts = annotate_heatmap(im, valfmt="{x:.0f}")

    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('Images\\VI-Forest-Per_Heatmap-' + str(size) + '.png')
    plt.show()

    # Plot Iterations Heatmap
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    im, cbar = heatmap(iters_hm, gammas, epsilons, ax=ax,
                       cmap="YlGn", cbarlabel="# of Iterations to Convergence")
    texts = annotate_heatmap(im, valfmt="{x:.0f}")

    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('Images\\VI-Forest-Iter_Heatmap-' + str(size) + '.png')
    plt.show()

    # Plot Run time Heatmap
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    im, cbar = heatmap(time_hm, gammas, epsilons, ax=ax,
                       cmap="YlGn", cbarlabel="Runtime (ms)")
    texts = annotate_heatmap(im, valfmt="{x:.1}")

    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('Images\\VI-Forest-Time_Heatmap-' + str(size) + '.png')
    plt.show()

    # Plot out optimal policy
    # Citation: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/52566969/python-mapping-a-2d-array-to-a-grid-with-pyplot
    cmap = colors.ListedColormap(['blue', 'red'])
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 3.75))
    plt.title("Forest VI Policy - Red = Cut, Blue = Wait")
    gammas.reverse()
    ax.set_yticklabels(gammas, fontsize=15)
    plt.xticks(fontsize=15)
    ax.tick_params(left=False)  # remove the ticks
    plt.xlabel('State', fontsize=15)
    plt.ylabel('Gamma', fontsize=15)
    plt.pcolor(best_pol_arr[::-1], cmap=cmap, edgecolors='k', linewidths=0)
    plt.savefig('Images\\VI-Forest-Heatmap-' + str(size) + '.png')

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
import mdptoolbox.example
import numpy as np
import random
from hiive.mdptoolbox import mdp
from matplotlib import colors
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt


def _image_path(filename):
    path = Path("Images")
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path / filename


# Citation: https://learning.oreilly.com/library/view/reinforcement-learning-algorithms/9781789131116/7c6dfed0-1180-49fe-84a0-ea62131b5947.xhtml

# Citation: https://matplotlib.org/3.1.1/gallery/images_contours_and_fields/image_annotated_heatmap.html
def heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, ax=None, cbar_kw={}, cbarlabel="", **kwargs):
    if ax is None:
        ax = plt.gca()

    im = ax.imshow(data, **kwargs)
    cbar = ax.figure.colorbar(im, ax=ax, **cbar_kw)
    cbar.ax.set_ylabel(cbarlabel, rotation=-90, va="bottom")

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1]))
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0]))
    ax.set_xticklabels(col_labels)
    ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels)
    ax.tick_params(top=True, bottom=False, labeltop=True, labelbottom=False)
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=-30, ha="right", rotation_mode="anchor")
    plt.title("epsilon")
    plt.ylabel("gamma")

    for _, spine in ax.spines.items():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1] + 1) - 0.5, minor=True)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0] + 1) - 0.5, minor=True)
    ax.grid(which="minor", color="w", linestyle="-", linewidth=3)
    ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)

    return im, cbar


def annotate_heatmap(im, data=None, valfmt="{x:.2f}", textcolors=["black", "white"], threshold=None, **textkw):
    if not isinstance(data, (list, np.ndarray)):
        data = im.get_array()

    if threshold is not None:
        threshold = im.norm(threshold)
    else:
        threshold = im.norm(np.nanmax(data)) / 2.0

    kw = dict(horizontalalignment="center", verticalalignment="center")
    kw.update(textkw)

    if isinstance(valfmt, str):
        valfmt = matplotlib.ticker.StrMethodFormatter(valfmt)

    texts = []
    for i in range(data.shape[0]):
        for j in range(data.shape[1]):
            value = data[i, j]
            if np.isnan(value):
                display = "nan"
                color = textcolors[0]
            else:
                display = valfmt(value, None)
                color = textcolors[int(im.norm(value) > threshold)]
            kw.update(color=color)
            texts.append(im.axes.text(j, i, display, **kw))

    return texts


def run_episodes(policy, S, R, p, num_episodes, num_resets):
    rewards = []
    for _ in range(int(num_resets)):
        state = 0
        total_reward = 0.0
        for _ in range(int(num_episodes)):
            state = min(int(state), int(S) - 1)
            if np.random.rand() < p:
                state = 0
                continue

            action = int(policy[state])
            total_reward += float(R[state][action])
            if action == 1:
                state = 0
            else:
                state = min(state + 1, int(S) - 1)
        rewards.append(total_reward)
    return float(np.mean(rewards)) if rewards else 0.0


def _plot_heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, label, filename, valfmt):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    im, _ = heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, ax=ax, cmap="YlGn", cbarlabel=label)
    annotate_heatmap(im, valfmt=valfmt)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(filename))
    plt.close(fig)


def _plot_run_stats(run_stats, size):
    if not run_stats:
        return

    iterations = [item.get("Iteration", index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(run_stats)]
    mean_v = [item.get("Mean V", np.nan) for item in run_stats]
    error = [item.get("Error", np.nan) for item in run_stats]
    reward = [item.get("Reward", np.nan) for item in run_stats]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(iterations, mean_v, label="Mean V")
    ax.plot(iterations, error, label="Error")
    ax.plot(iterations, reward, label="Reward")
    ax.legend(loc="best")
    ax.set_xlabel("Iterations", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_ylabel("Value / Error / Reward", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_title("Value Iteration Convergence")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(f"VI-Forest-run-stats-{size}.png"))
    plt.close(fig)


def _plot_policy(policy_rows, gammas, size, prefix):
    if not policy_rows:
        return
    cmap = colors.ListedColormap(["blue", "red"])
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 3.75))
    ax.set_title(f"Forest {prefix} Policy - Red = Cut, Blue = Wait")
    ax.set_xlabel("State", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_ylabel("Gamma", fontsize=15)
    ax.tick_params(left=False)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(gammas)) + 0.5)
    ax.set_yticklabels([str(gamma) for gamma in gammas], fontsize=12)
    ax.pcolor(np.asarray(policy_rows), cmap=cmap, edgecolors="k", linewidths=0)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(f"{prefix}-Forest-Policy-{size}.png"))
    plt.close(fig)


def run_forest(size):
    seed_val = 42
    np.random.seed(seed_val)
    random.seed(seed_val)

    S = int(size)
    r1 = 10
    r2 = 50
    p = 0.1
    P, R = mdptoolbox.example.forest(S=S, r1=r1, r2=r2, p=p)

    gammas = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.99]
    epsilons = [0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001]

    reward_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))
    iter_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))
    time_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))

    best_reward = -np.inf
    best_policy_rows = []
    best_run_stats = []

    for gamma_index, gamma in enumerate(gammas):
        row_best_reward = -np.inf
        row_best_policy = None

        for epsilon_index, epsilon in enumerate(epsilons):
            solver = mdp.ValueIteration(P, R, gamma=gamma, epsilon=epsilon)
            solver.run()

            reward = run_episodes(solver.policy, S, R, p, num_episodes=1000, num_resets=25)
            reward_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = reward
            iter_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = solver.iter
            time_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = solver.time * 1000.0

            if reward > row_best_reward:
                row_best_reward = reward
                row_best_policy = np.asarray(solver.policy, dtype=int)

            if reward > best_reward:
                best_reward = reward
                best_run_stats = list(solver.run_stats)

        if row_best_policy is not None:
            best_policy_rows.append(row_best_policy)

    _plot_run_stats(best_run_stats, S)
    _plot_heatmap(reward_hm, gammas, epsilons, "Average Reward", f"VI-Forest-Per_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.0f}")
    _plot_heatmap(iter_hm, gammas, epsilons, "# of Iterations to Convergence", f"VI-Forest-Iter_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.0f}")
    _plot_heatmap(time_hm, gammas, epsilons, "Runtime (ms)", f"VI-Forest-Time_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.1f}")
    _plot_policy(best_policy_rows, gammas, S, "VI")

    return {
        "gammas": gammas,
        "epsilons": epsilons,
        "reward_heatmap": reward_hm,
        "iterations_heatmap": iter_hm,
        "time_heatmap": time_hm,
        "best_reward": float(best_reward),
        "best_policy_rows": best_policy_rows,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_forest(10)
    run_forest(1000)

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
import mdptoolbox.example
import numpy as np
import random
from hiive.mdptoolbox import mdp
from matplotlib import colors
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt


def _image_path(filename):
    path = Path("Images")
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path / filename


# Citation: https://learning.oreilly.com/library/view/reinforcement-learning-algorithms/9781789131116/7c6dfed0-1180-49fe-84a0-ea62131b5947.xhtml

# Citation: https://matplotlib.org/3.1.1/gallery/images_contours_and_fields/image_annotated_heatmap.html
def heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, ax=None, cbar_kw={}, cbarlabel="", **kwargs):
    if ax is None:
        ax = plt.gca()

    im = ax.imshow(data, **kwargs)
    cbar = ax.figure.colorbar(im, ax=ax, **cbar_kw)
    cbar.ax.set_ylabel(cbarlabel, rotation=-90, va="bottom")

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1]))
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0]))
    ax.set_xticklabels(col_labels)
    ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels)
    ax.tick_params(top=True, bottom=False, labeltop=True, labelbottom=False)
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=-30, ha="right", rotation_mode="anchor")
    plt.title("epsilon")
    plt.ylabel("gamma")

    for _, spine in ax.spines.items():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1] + 1) - 0.5, minor=True)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0] + 1) - 0.5, minor=True)
    ax.grid(which="minor", color="w", linestyle="-", linewidth=3)
    ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)

    return im, cbar


def annotate_heatmap(im, data=None, valfmt="{x:.2f}", textcolors=["black", "white"], threshold=None, **textkw):
    if not isinstance(data, (list, np.ndarray)):
        data = im.get_array()

    if threshold is not None:
        threshold = im.norm(threshold)
    else:
        threshold = im.norm(np.nanmax(data)) / 2.0

    kw = dict(horizontalalignment="center", verticalalignment="center")
    kw.update(textkw)

    if isinstance(valfmt, str):
        valfmt = matplotlib.ticker.StrMethodFormatter(valfmt)

    texts = []
    for i in range(data.shape[0]):
        for j in range(data.shape[1]):
            value = data[i, j]
            if np.isnan(value):
                display = "nan"
                color = textcolors[0]
            else:
                display = valfmt(value, None)
                color = textcolors[int(im.norm(value) > threshold)]
            kw.update(color=color)
            texts.append(im.axes.text(j, i, display, **kw))

    return texts


def run_episodes(policy, S, R, p, num_episodes, num_resets):
    rewards = []
    for _ in range(int(num_resets)):
        state = 0
        total_reward = 0.0
        for _ in range(int(num_episodes)):
            state = min(int(state), int(S) - 1)
            if np.random.rand() < p:
                state = 0
                continue

            action = int(policy[state])
            total_reward += float(R[state][action])
            if action == 1:
                state = 0
            else:
                state = min(state + 1, int(S) - 1)
        rewards.append(total_reward)
    return float(np.mean(rewards)) if rewards else 0.0


def _plot_heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, label, filename, valfmt):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    im, _ = heatmap(data, row_labels, col_labels, ax=ax, cmap="YlGn", cbarlabel=label)
    annotate_heatmap(im, valfmt=valfmt)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(filename))
    plt.close(fig)


def _plot_run_stats(run_stats, size):
    if not run_stats:
        return

    iterations = [item.get("Iteration", index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(run_stats)]
    mean_v = [item.get("Mean V", np.nan) for item in run_stats]
    error = [item.get("Error", np.nan) for item in run_stats]
    reward = [item.get("Reward", np.nan) for item in run_stats]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(iterations, mean_v, label="Mean V")
    ax.plot(iterations, error, label="Error")
    ax.plot(iterations, reward, label="Reward")
    ax.legend(loc="best")
    ax.set_xlabel("Iterations", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_ylabel("Value / Error / Reward", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_title("Policy Iteration Convergence")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(f"PI-Forest-run-stats-{size}.png"))
    plt.close(fig)


def _plot_policy(policy_rows, gammas, size, prefix):
    if not policy_rows:
        return
    cmap = colors.ListedColormap(["blue", "red"])
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 3.75))
    ax.set_title(f"Forest {prefix} Policy - Red = Cut, Blue = Wait")
    ax.set_xlabel("State", fontsize=15)
    ax.set_ylabel("Gamma", fontsize=15)
    ax.tick_params(left=False)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(gammas)) + 0.5)
    ax.set_yticklabels([str(gamma) for gamma in gammas], fontsize=12)
    ax.pcolor(np.asarray(policy_rows), cmap=cmap, edgecolors="k", linewidths=0)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(_image_path(f"{prefix}-Forest-Policy-{size}.png"))
    plt.close(fig)


def run_forest(size):
    seed_val = 42
    np.random.seed(seed_val)
    random.seed(seed_val)

    S = int(size)
    r1 = 10
    r2 = 50
    p = 0.1
    P, R = mdptoolbox.example.forest(S=S, r1=r1, r2=r2, p=p)

    gammas = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.99]
    epsilons = [0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001]

    reward_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))
    iter_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))
    time_hm = np.zeros((len(gammas), len(epsilons)))

    best_reward = -np.inf
    best_gamma = gammas[0]
    best_policy_rows = []

    # Use the modified variant for the epsilon sweep; the standard PolicyIteration
    # implementation is rerun on the best gamma below to capture run statistics.
    for gamma_index, gamma in enumerate(gammas):
        row_best_reward = -np.inf
        row_best_policy = None

        for epsilon_index, epsilon in enumerate(epsilons):
            solver = mdp.PolicyIterationModified(P, R, gamma=gamma, epsilon=epsilon, max_iter=1000)
            solver.run()

            reward = run_episodes(solver.policy, S, R, p, num_episodes=1000, num_resets=25)
            reward_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = reward
            iter_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = solver.iter
            time_hm[gamma_index, epsilon_index] = solver.time * 1000.0

            if reward > row_best_reward:
                row_best_reward = reward
                row_best_policy = np.asarray(solver.policy, dtype=int)

            if reward > best_reward:
                best_reward = reward
                best_gamma = gamma

        if row_best_policy is not None:
            best_policy_rows.append(row_best_policy)

    stats_solver = mdp.PolicyIteration(P, R, gamma=best_gamma, max_iter=1000)
    stats_solver.run()

    _plot_run_stats(list(stats_solver.run_stats), S)
    _plot_heatmap(reward_hm, gammas, epsilons, "Average Reward", f"PI-Forest-Per_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.0f}")
    _plot_heatmap(iter_hm, gammas, epsilons, "# of Iterations to Convergence", f"PI-Forest-Iter_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.0f}")
    _plot_heatmap(time_hm, gammas, epsilons, "Runtime (ms)", f"PI-Forest-Time_Heatmap-{S}.png", "{x:.1f}")
    _plot_policy(best_policy_rows, gammas, S, "PI")

    return {
        "gammas": gammas,
        "epsilons": epsilons,
        "reward_heatmap": reward_hm,
        "iterations_heatmap": iter_hm,
        "time_heatmap": time_hm,
        "best_reward": float(best_reward),
        "best_gamma": float(best_gamma),
        "best_policy_rows": best_policy_rows,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_forest(10)
    run_forest(1000)
